correctness.rationale: Re-derived optimal opinion y_i=c z_i+d x_i and action payoff increment K(z_i-1/2-eta), with all normalization and zero diagonal accounted for. Within-block comparison forces action homogeneity in every strict equilibrium; exact block linear solution then gives all four candidate configurations and sharp parameter inequalities, with equality excluded. Python standard-library exact rational full-profile checker passed 864 parameter/network cases and 96,768 profiles plus three equality boundaries. The real-parameter infinite statement rests on the complete algebraic proof.

originality.rationale: The first-public 2026 coevolutionary public-goods article proves the best-response and sufficient consensus results but explicitly leaves mixed equilibria open. The present new contribution is the complete necessary-and-sufficient structural classification in the two-community homogeneous network and the exact onset threshold. Two earlier coevolution papers prove sufficient polarized-equilibrium criteria for distinct games with neighbor-action coordination/anti-coordination, whose action increments are not the constant negative public-goods increment. Equivalent unindexed work remains possible.
residual_risks: An unindexed or unpublished exact block-network classification could imply the result; novelty is not independently certified.

value.rationale: Mixed cooperation/defection was an explicit unresolved direction in the motivating paper. The theorem gives a complete classification of robust equilibria for a canonical modular network, proves impossibility of within-community action mixing, and identifies a necessary-and-sufficient, sharp, population-size-independent (at fixed r/n) segregation threshold. This supplies structural information beyond routine consensus inequalities, numerical enumeration or a single unmotivated parameter example.
